game_concept: A puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Wind Pass, a howling mountain pass: the summit pilot must handle avalanches while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – F-String Herald: Format messages with f-strings that insert live values for announcements.
theme: Frost Peaks – Wind Pass: a howling mountain pass
core_gameplay_loop: In Wind Pass, repeat each round: Format messages with f-strings that insert live values for announcements. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the announcements value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the cliff anchor using at most 10 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The cliff anchor reached with actions_used <= 10.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the cliff anchor is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 1 (intro tier): F-String Herald
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'F-String Herald' (Week 8 slot 13), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Wind Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how announcements changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against avalanches in Wind Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The cliff anchor reached with actions_used <= 10.
